commits.content:
spring:
    application:
        name: happy-pet-shop

    datasource:
        url: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL}
        username: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME}
        password: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD}
    jpa:
        hibernate:
            ddl-auto: validate
        show-sql: true
        properties:
            hibernate:
                format_sql: true
    flyway:
        enabled: true
        locations: classpath:db/migration
        baseline-on-migrate: true
        baseline-version: 0
    redis:
        host: ${SPRING_REDIS_HOST}
        port: ${SPRING_REDIS_PORT}
#        password: root   # Optional
        timeout: 2000ms
        lettuce:
            pool:
                max-active: 8
                max-idle: 8
                min-idle: 0
                max-wait: -1ms
    cache:
        type: redis
        redis:
            time-to-live: 600000  # 10 minutes in milliseconds
            cache-null-values: false
            use-key-prefix: true
            key-prefix: "happypetshop:"

    security:
        oauth2:
            client:
                registration:
                    google:
                        client-id: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}
                        client-secret: ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}
                        scope:
                            - openid
                            - profile
                            - email

server:
    port: 8080
    servlet:
        context-path: /happy-pet-shop

jwt:
    key: ${JWT_KEY}
    expiration-time: 3600 #seconds
    refreshExpiration-time: 604800 #seconds
